top_creatures.label: Pack-caller guardian
top_creatures.why: A guardian that switches to a call-for-help state while engaged makes a fight spread to the area; the call is a readable beat the player can see coming.
top_creatures.keep: kept: three states (idle, engaged, signalling) with the call as its own state.
top_creatures.change: changed: our call radius, who answers and how, a visible wind-up before the call, and a cooldown.

top_creatures.label: Fast-orbit caller
top_creatures.why: While signalling, the NPC orbits its target at twice its orbit speed; the faster movement is the tell that a call is in progress.
top_creatures.keep: kept: the caller moves faster during the call, so the movement is the tell.
top_creatures.change: changed: our tell (posture and colour, not only speed), a cap on how long the call lasts, and a rule for who it calls.

top_creatures.label: Swarm approach-pursue-depart cycle
top_creatures.why: A swarm that approaches, pursues and departs in a clear cycle reads as a living pack rather than a static group.
top_creatures.keep: kept: approach, pursuit and departure as the three visible phases.
top_creatures.change: changed: the swarm returns to a den when its target drops out, not to its owner; our own phase timings.

top_creatures.label: Attack timer and leash check
top_creatures.why: Each attack waits on a timer and first checks the target is still inside the zone; a target that leaves is dropped without a special case.
top_creatures.keep: kept: an attack gate on a timer and a zone-membership check before each attack.
top_creatures.change: changed: our leash radius per family and the drop rule (drop, or pull back to the spawn point).

top_creatures.label: Target-lost fallback
top_creatures.why: When the current target is lost, the NPC returns to idle only if no targets remain; otherwise it takes the first remaining target. This is the many-on-one choice point the team has not yet made smarter.
top_creatures.keep: kept: the fallback to the next remaining target instead of an idle stop.
top_creatures.change: changed: pick the next target by threat or a hate list (our rule), not the first in the list; the donor's own TODO asks for the weakest.

top_creatures.label: Faction-side wave
top_creatures.why: Groups that appear from the direction where their faction has presence feel like they came from somewhere, not from the air. The TODO describes it; it is not built.
top_creatures.keep: kept: the spawn origin is picked along the faction side of the zone.
top_creatures.change: changed: our own spawn grammar; with no faction presence, spawn from a random edge point as the donor's TODO suggests.

top_creatures.label: Wave near a set-piece
top_creatures.why: Dungeon waves placed near set-piece objects, not in the middle of the zone, make the room's objects matter. The TODO describes it; it is not built.
top_creatures.keep: kept: spawn anchored to a set-piece object.
top_creatures.change: changed: our own placement rule and anchor types.

top_creatures.label: Dormant sleeper
top_creatures.why: A group that sits still until the player is close is a classic zone-tension device; the name alone is worth keeping as a category.
top_creatures.keep: kept: the category (a dormant guardian that wakes on proximity).
top_creatures.change: changed: everything else; the wake rule, look and behaviour are ours. Behaviour in the donor was not read.

originals.name: Signal-the-pack guardian
originals.idea: A guardian that stands watch and, once engaged, winds up to call others in. The call is visible for a beat before the others come.
originals.keep: kept: three states (watch, engaged, call) with the call as its own state.
originals.change: changed: our call radius, the wind-up pose, who answers (family only), and a cooldown; our own names and look.

originals.name: Fast-orbit tell
originals.idea: While it calls, the caller moves faster around its target, so the player reads the call from motion.
originals.keep: kept: motion as the tell during the call.
originals.change: changed: a posture and colour tell instead of speed alone; a call length cap; no orbit, a strafe instead.

originals.name: Swarm cycle
originals.idea: A small swarm approaches, pursues, then withdraws to a den on a clear cycle.
originals.keep: kept: approach, pursuit and withdrawal as three visible phases.
originals.change: changed: the den is a zone object, not the owner; our own timing; the swarm reforms after a set time.

originals.name: Faction-side wave
originals.idea: Waves enter from the side of the zone where the local faction is strongest, so the threat has a direction.
originals.keep: kept: spawn origin chosen along the faction side.
originals.change: changed: our spawn grammar; with no faction presence, a random edge point; our own faction strength rule.

originals.name: Archetype-tagged zones
originals.idea: Each zone carries one archetype tag that picks its rules, spawn set and reward table in one place.
originals.keep: kept: one archetype field as the data hook for the zone.
originals.change: changed: our archetypes (for example trail, gauntlet, shrine, escalation); our own rules per archetype.

originals.name: Three-pool durability
originals.idea: Defence is three pools in order: a shield layer, then armour, then structure; a boost effect adds to one pool, and damage drains them in order.
originals.keep: kept: three ordered pools and a boost that targets one pool.
originals.change: changed: our pool names and recharge rule (recharge after a quiet period); a visible pool state on the model.

originals.name: Overload-only effect
originals.idea: A powerful effect exists only while a piece of gear is pushed into overload, so the player chooses when to risk it.
originals.keep: kept: an effect gated by an overload state.
originals.change: changed: our overload cost (health, cooldown or a stamina cost) and an aura that shows the state.

originals.name: Fleet aura at engage
originals.idea: A leader's aura is applied when the fleet engages and removed when the leader dies, not at formation time.
originals.keep: kept: the leader aura as a data-driven modifier.
originals.change: changed: applied at engage, cached on the squad, removed on leader death (fixing the donor's late calculation TODO); our own aura numbers.
